record.field: Initial Contact Acknowledgment
general
Sent when a new lead contacts the hospital for the first time

Hello {{first_name}}, thank you for contacting Ruhunu Hospital. One of our Patient Relationship Managers will call you shortly to discuss your inquiry. For urgent assistance, call us at {{phone_number}}.
Appointment Confirmation
appointment
Sent to confirm an upcoming appointment
Dear {{first_name}}, your appointment is scheduled at {{appointment_date}}. Please remember to follow medical instructions before your arrival at our center. See you soon! Ruhunu Hospital.
Missed Appointment Follow-up
follow_up
Sent when a patient misses their scheduled appointment
Hi {{first_name}}, we missed you today for your appointment. Your health is important to us. Would you like to reschedule for later this week? Call us {{phone_number}}. Ruhunu Hospital.
Post-Visit Care Reminder
follow_up
Sent after a patient visit to remind about medications

Dear {{first_name}}, we hope you are recovering well at home. A quick reminder to take your prescribed medications as directed. For any concerns, our 24/7 nursing line is {{phone_number}}. Ruhunu Hospital.
Feedback Request
feedback
Sent to request patient feedback after service
Hi {{first_name}}, thank you for choosing Ruhunu Hospital. We value your feedback. Could you please rate your experience with us? {{link}}. Your input helps us serve you better.
